claims.sentence: For your final certification, the required components depend on whether you are enrolled in a professional retraining program or an advanced training program
If you are in a professional retraining program, your final assessment consists of a final interdisciplinary exam and the preparation and defense of a graduation certification (qualification) work

If you are in an advanced training program, your final assessment includes an exam, the preparation and defense of a graduation certification (qualification) work, a credit test for the training program, and other types provided by the DPP
Regarding the evaluation body, the final assessment for advanced training programs is, as a rule, conducted without forming an examination commission
The regulations do not specify whether an examination commission is formed for professional retraining programs
The evidence does not specify the format, duration, or grading criteria for the exams or the graduation work
It does not state whether an examination commission is required for professional retraining programs
The phrase "other types, provided by the DPP" means the exact assessment components for advanced training programs may vary depending on your specific program
The regulations do not address what happens if you fail any component of the final assessment
